description: P5 baseline. Latency and ECS come from ee_bench on the stand-in engines (config/pipeline.yaml, 9 utterances, real-time paced, WSL2 x86-64 dev machine). Emotion UAR comes from ml/eval/eval_emotion.py on the phase-2 C++ models: emotion2vec+ base on RAVDESS speech (1440 clips; the prosody-rules stand-in scored 0.177) and DistilRoBERTa on the MELD test split (2610 utterances; the lexicon stand-in scored 0.214). chrF comes from ml/eval/eval_mt.py on FLORES-200 devtest eng->hin with the phase-2 NLLB-600M emotion LoRA fed the runtime's neutral prefix (vanilla NLLB-600M INT8: 55.79). Re-baseline per engine configuration and target hardware with --update-baseline.
